newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korea to cut semiconductor tariff in July.
newsitem.headline: South Korea to cut semiconductor tariff in July.

text.p: South Korea will cut import tax on semiconductors to four percent in July from the current eight percent, trade ministry officials said on Friday.
The tariff will be cut further to two percent in January 1998 and be lifted the following year, they said.

South Korea earlier planned to cut the import tax to six percent in July and four percent in 1998 but decided to speed up the plan as part of efforts to help liberalise global semiconductor trade, they said.
